notes: IFIP_SEC-X01_receipt_schema (Phase P02, RQ1): defined the canonical context-bound authorization receipt as JSON Schema draft 2020-12 (stdlib subset) at research/venue2027/ifip_sec/protocols/receipt.schema.json. All thirteen required fields canonicalized with additionalProperties:false: version (const '1', unknown versions fail closed with CONST_MISMATCH), tenant, principal, purpose (snake_case purpose-of-use), delegated_actor, operation (dotted governed-operation label), proposal_lineage_hash (lowercase 64-hex SHA-256, the X02 dispatch-digest binding incl. parent reference), policy_epoch, consent_epoch, nonce (>=16-char URL-safe consume-once token; atomic consumption remains X03's linearizable duty), issued_at/expiry (strict UTC RFC 3339) and signature{algorithm(HMAC-SHA256),value(64-hex)}. Fail closed throughout: no credential material, no health value - injected clinical fields are hard ADDITIONAL_PROPERTY rejections, tested explicitly. The stdlib 2020-12 subset cannot compare two instance fields, so 'expiry strictly after issued_at' is encoded as strict UTC timestamps in the schema and ENFORCED by the composed validator in the test driver with stable reason codes (TEMPORAL_ORDER for expiry<=issued_at, TIMESTAMP_UNPARSEABLE for indeterminate parses - never a silent pass). Test driver research/venue2027/ifip_sec/tests/test_receipt_schema.py (18 tests) imports ONLY the schema JSON and the shared stdlib validator (no candidate verifier - oracle independence preserved): 3+ positive receipts (canonical non-delegated with actor==principal, delegated multi-hop with distinct epochs and microsecond timestamps, boundary expiry one second after issuance, required-field completeness) and adversarial coverage (missing signature at both levels, expiry == issued_at, expiry < issued_at, four malformed proposal_lineage_hash variants, short signature value, unknown extra field, injected diagnosis text, missing nonce, unknown version, unknown signature algorithm, garbage timestamp, empty/wrong-type fields). 18 passed; uvx ruff@0.7.1 check clean on research/venue2027/ifip_sec/. No production path touched; no live provider, clock or randomness; no real PostgreSQL condition claimed (schema-only task). baseline_parity=NOT_APPLICABLE (structural contract, not a decision comparator; baseline arms B0-B4 are exercised by X05/X06). source_sha_after records the base commit e2f63ccb per the established sibling convention (IFIP_SEC-X06, POPETS-X06); the single task commit SHA is created immediately after this report and recorded in the commit body. Downstream consumers: IFIP_SEC-X02_lineage_digest, X03_nonce_store, X04_context_verify.
